completion_only_use: Use realized-return statistics only as cross-sectional sensitivity on completed election outcomes.
headline_use: Use expected PnL, capacity, and nested-OOS probability metrics for the forward-looking strategy.
historical_scope_comparison: All-tradable and completion-only are identical in this run because the executable historical blotter contains no terminated or withdrawn events.

historical_sharpe_method.calendar_day_variant: Business days with no active trade are included as zero returns.
historical_sharpe_method.costs: Transaction costs, financing, and borrow fees are not deducted.
historical_sharpe_method.return_path: Daily target/acquirer price P&L using the selected hedge ratio; the final day reconciles to the observed settlement return when available. Otherwise the market-to-deadline path is retained as an explicit fallback.
historical_sharpe_method.sharpe: Mean daily return / daily standard deviation * sqrt(252), zero risk-free rate.

not_claimed: No annualized strategy Sharpe or investable Sortino is claimed because broken deals lack realized election demand.
sortino_definition: Mean realized return divided by downside deviation relative to a 0% minimum acceptable return.
source_note: Cross-sectional realized-return diagnostics on the completed-election sample. Deal breaks are absent from realized election returns, so mean/std and Sortino are sensitivity statistics, not investable or annualized strategy ratios.
